$comment: Fonts DAK owns, as opposed to fonts vendored from upstream. These are not in vendor-manifest.json because they are not drift from penkrahq/penkra-apps: upstream resolves them from its own npm dependencies and ships no font files for them. Keeping them here keeps canvas-vendor.ts check clean while still recording where every byte came from.

source.$comment: Taken as the official TTF. The vendored engine's font map names a .woff2 for this face, but bytes reach provider.registerFont unmodified and CanvasKit needs TTF/OTF, so a woff2 would fail to load. Renamed from JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf to the weight the engine asks for.
As above, from the official TTF rather than the woff2 @fontsource would give.
